question: do the four eff_* efficiencies move any PUBLISHED winner verdict (N8/N16/N32 ring, seq 8192)?
method: 17 points per parameter across its stated range, winner_cell() from scripts/error_budget.py, compared against the default-valued winner
answer: no flips: all four are verdict-inert across their stated ranges on all three cells
caveat_sampled: 17-point sampling, not a bisection; a flip between samples is possible but would need a sub-sample-sized coincidence
caveat_metric: winner-stable is not metric-stable: step time can move without changing the ranking, so an absolute-time claim is not covered by this result
consequence: grading eff_* on one GPU cannot change a published conclusion, so the single-GPU measurement I had flagged as the remaining opportunity is NOT worth GPU time; ranking first is what established that.
